values./system/description:
his gas-operated rifle is a common sight across the wasteland, and well-liked because of the low recoil and reasonable accuracy, and the ease of modifications. Most versions found are only capable of semi-automatic fire, but the weapon is easily modified for automatic fire.

An Assault Rifle can accept one each of the following mods:

  • Receiver: Calibrated, Hardened, Automatic, Hair Trigger, Powerful, Advanced
  • Barrel: Long Barrel, Ported Barrel, Vented Barrel
  • Stock: Full Stock, Marksman’s Stock, RecoilCompensating Stock
  • Magazine: Large Magazine, Quick-Eject Magazine, Large Quick-Eject Magazine
  • Sights: Reflex Sight, Short Scope, Long Scope, Short Night Vision Scope, Long Night Vision Scope, Recon Scope
  • Muzzle: Compensator, Suppressor
